title: Inverse image of a locally split sequence is sectionwise surjective
statement: Let g : Y → X be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], T a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on X, W an open of X such that the restriction of T.f to W is a split monomorphism, and B an open of Y contained in g⁻¹(W). The inverse-image quotient map [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] is surjective on sections over B. There is no cover hypothesis.

source.place: Inverse-image splitting paragraph, expanded using Mathlib sheafPullbackIso and ShortComplex.Splitting.ofExactOfRetraction.

proof.text: Mathlib sheafPullbackIso identifies open restriction with inverse image along the inclusion. It preserves limits; the pullback adjunction makes it a left adjoint, hence it preserves colimits. ShortExact.map_of_exact therefore preserves the short exact sequence on W. Splitting.ofExactOfRetraction supplies a splitting from the assumed retraction and exactness, hence a split quotient map.

Construct the continuous map p : B → W explicitly by b ↦ g(b), using hB. The two composites into X are definitionally equal. Compose the pullback adjunctions and use leftAdjointUniq to obtain pullbackCompIso. Whisker this with the two open-restriction isomorphisms to identify W-restriction followed by p-pullback with g-pullback followed by B-restriction. Naturality conjugates the two quotient morphisms. Functors and conjugation by isomorphisms preserve split epimorphisms.

Forget to presheaves and evaluate at the top open of B. This preserves the split epimorphism. AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective gives surjectivity. The image of the top open under the subtype inclusion is B, as proved elementwise in htop, so this is exactly the required section map. Empty B or W is included without extra assumptions.

theorem inverseImage_surjective_sections_of_localSplit
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (T : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hT : T.ShortExact) (W : X.Opens)
    (hsplit : IsSplitMono (W.sheafRestrict.map T.f))
    (B : Y.Opens) (hB : B ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W) :
    Function.Surjective (((invImage g).map T.g).hom.app (op B))
